meta.name: cloud-functions
meta.description: CloudBase function runtime guide for building, deploying, and debugging your own Event Functions or HTTP Functions. This skill should be used when users need application runtime code on CloudBase, not when they are merely calling CloudBase official platform APIs.

copy.tagline: 在云开发上构建、部署和调试云函数
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在云开发平台上编写和运行云函数
copy.tagline_en: Build, deploy, and debug cloud functions on CloudBase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write and run cloud functions on CloudBase

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，Claude能帮你创建、修改、部署和调试腾讯云CloudBase的云函数（事件函数和HTTP函数），包括编写代码、选择函数类型、处理配置和网关。
howto.when: 当你想开发、部署或调试CloudBase云函数，或提到“函数运行时”“函数日志”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个HTTP函数，监听9000端口。
say.note: Claude会生成HTTP函数代码并指导部署。

say.text: 部署我写的事件函数代码。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can help you create, modify, deploy, and debug CloudBase cloud functions (Event Functions or HTTP Functions) on Tencent Cloud, including writing code, choosing the runtime model, handling configurations, and setting up gateways.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to develop, deploy, or debug CloudBase cloud functions, or when mentioning keywords like 'function runtime' or 'function logs'.

say_en.text: Create an HTTP function listening on port 9000.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the HTTP function code and guide deployment.
Claude will use MCP tools to deploy the function.
